subject: Joint podcast and case study — publicity/license in exchange for deal credit (Novus Health)
messages:
From: Claire Jamison <claire@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Potential co-marketing: podcast + case study (Novus pilot)

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from the Novus side — we’re nearing the end of our pilot and are excited about the early results. Our marketing team mentioned they’d love to run a customer spotlight (podcast episode + written case study) that highlights the integration and outcomes.

In exchange, would Redwood be open to providing a commercial concession for the pilot (a credit applied to our first 3 billed months)? We’re thinking an endorsement + logo usage (in press and on your site), a 30–40 minute recorded podcast segment, and a short written case study (quote and metrics).

We can sign a publicity release; I’ve attached our brand guidelines so you can see logo usage rules. Let me know if this sounds possible and who we should coordinate with internally.

Best,
Claire Jamison
Head of Marketing, Novus Health
[attachment: novus_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jamison <claire@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Potential co-marketing: podcast + case study (Novus pilot)

Hi Claire — thanks, this is great to hear and congrats on the pilot progress. We’d absolutely like to explore a co-marketing package.

High-level I think we can consider a billing credit in exchange for the assets you describe. Before I commit commercially, I need to confirm three items with our deal desk and legal:

- Exact nature of the concession (credit percent / duration).
- Scope of publicity rights (logo, quote, case study placement, podcast publishing rights, exclusivity if any).
- Approvals and sign-off process (marketing approvals + legal publicity release).

Proposed starting point from my side: 20% credit applied to first three months of billed usage for the pilot, plus a non-exclusive right to publish the written case study and the podcast episode (we will share quote and draft for your sign-off). I’ll loop in my manager and legal to confirm whether that concession needs executive sign-off.

Marissa — can you and legal weigh in on whether 20% x 3 months is approvable at the deal desk level or whether we need an escalation? Also copying CS (Lauren) so they can coordinate distribution and customer readiness for a recorded session.

Claire — attaching a short draft of proposed co-marketing terms we can start with.

— Soojin
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_co_marketing_terms_v1.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Claire Jamison <claire@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Potential co-marketing: podcast + case study (Novus pilot) — escalation for approval

Looping in Deal Desk + Legal + VP Sales for a quick decision.

Summary: Novus (Strategic pilot account) offers a podcast + written case study + logo + quote in exchange for a commercial concession. Soojin proposes 20% credit x 3 months applied to billed usage. Customer is mid-market health tech with strong brand recognition in our target vertical — marketing exposure could materially help lead generation.

Request to approvers (Vivek, Rishi):
- Approve up to 25% credit for first 3 months OR advise counter (allowed authority at Deal Desk is up to 15% without VP ok). If >15%, we need VP sign-off.
- Confirm we can accept non-exclusive rights to publish Novus-branded assets that include a customer quote and logo on our marketing site and in a podcast episode. Important: customer requires pre-publication sign-off (standard).
- Confirm legal checklist for publicity (indemnity, trademark usage, approval windows, duration of license). Rishi — can you confirm a short template we can send to customer so this doesn’t delay timeline?

Risks / notes:
- If we grant >15% credit without clear measurement criteria, we risk setting a discount precedent. Recommend making concession conditional on 6-month usage minimum or a written case study live date within 90 days.
- Pod/publishing timeline: customer wants recording in mid-August; we should lock the publicity release within two weeks to hit that schedule.

Asks: Vivek — can you approve discretionary uplift to 25% for this pilot if you think the marketing ROI justifies it? Rishi — please attach the publicity-release template and call out anything that would block publication (e.g., customer confidentiality around metrics).

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Potential co-marketing: podcast + case study (Novus pilot) — escalation for approval

Thanks for the write-up. I’m supportive of a co-marketing approach for strategic healthcare accounts, but want to be conservative on financials.

Decision guidance:
- Approve up to 15% credit applied to first three billed months without additional exec approval.
- Anything above 15% (up to 25%) requires sign-off from SVP Sales (I can take to SVP if Marissa recommends). Provide expected pipeline uplift / net new ARR attribution and I’ll advocate.
- Publicity rights: OK for non-exclusive logo/quote use with pre-publication review. Legal to confirm template.

Operational asks:
- Make concession conditional on (a) customer commits to at least 6 months of paid usage post-pilot OR (b) Novus publishes the case study/podcast within 90 days of recording.
- Marketing to own the asset publication schedule and tracking of attributable leads. Lauren, please confirm you can prioritize the joint content in August/September.

If the customer absolutely needs 20% up front, Marissa — please prepare pipeline/ARR justification and I’ll escalate to SVP.

— Vivek
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Claire Jamison <claire@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Potential co-marketing: podcast + case study (Novus pilot) — publicity checklist and next steps

Marissa / Soojin / Vivek — attaching the lightweight publicity-release template we can use to capture usage rights and approvals. Key items to include in the release:

- Parties and limited license (non-exclusive, revocable for material breach)
- Permitted uses (website, press, podcast embed, social) and file formats
- Approval process for customer quotes (48-hour review window)
- Trademark/logo guidelines and authorized assets (we need Novus brand pack)
- Duration of license (recommend 24 months) and termination for change of control/confidentiality conflicts
- Indemnity and no-waiver on confidential clinical data — call out that any patient-level metrics must be anonymized and pre-approved

I’ve attached the template and a DocuSign stub — Soojin, please send this to Claire with the proposed commercial concession (15% credit x 3 months per Vivek) and the operational conditions (6-month paid commitment OR publication within 90 days). Ask customer to confirm whether 15% is acceptable; if they counter to 20%, flag and I’ll prepare an escalated approval package for SVP.

Attachments: draft_publicity_release_template.pdf (PDF)
DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/templates/redwood-publicity-release

Rishi Malhotra
General Counsel (Contracts & IP), Redwood Inference
